content: The API gateway runs on port 8100 and fronts all service traffic.
The billing service listens on port 8101 and writes invoices to the ledger database.
The analytics worker runs nightly at 02:00 and posts results to the metrics database.
Service dashboards live in /srv/acme/dashboards and are served on port 8120.
The primary database is PostgreSQL 16 on port 5433 in the database container.
Alice owns the search team and reviews all retrieval changes.
Bob owns infrastructure and manages the Docker hosts.
The search index is rebuilt daily and takes about twelve minutes.
The staging environment mirrors production but uses a separate database.
The metrics database uses ClickHouse on port 8124.
API keys are rotated every ninety days per the security policy.
The deploy pipeline runs on Docker and takes about eight minutes.
Query p95 latency on the search service is forty milliseconds.
Alice prefers concise, direct answers in code reviews.
The benchmark model endpoint is the local inference host on port 9100.
